name: Mars Polar Lander
tagline: Lost during landing in 1999; the failure led NASA to review its “faster, better, cheaper” approach
description: Mars Polar Lander was a NASA lander built by Lockheed Martin. Contact was lost during its descent to the Martian south polar region in December 1999. Coming months after the loss of Mars Climate Orbiter, the failure led NASA to review its “faster, better, cheaper” approach.
best_known_for: Lost during landing in 1999; the failure led NASA to review its “faster, better, cheaper” approach
